Broadcom (AVGO) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 20.5 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
